mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for three consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 8.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a weak labor market that triggers Federal Reserve policy accommodation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE has exceeded 8.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand weakness, reducing corporate earnings expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect between HOUST and RSAFS does not produce negative returns in more than 60% of cases where both series decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO below 100), supply chain disruptions intensify, increasing input costs and reducing corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not negative in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO is below 100, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in housing starts (HOUST) over the past three months signals strong consumer confidence and rising demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where HOUST has increased for three consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.25%, it signals a shift toward monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.25%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and declines in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate labor market tightening that raises wage pressures and corporate costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect between PAYEMS and UNRATE does not produce negative returns in more than 60% of cases where both series move in the expected direction, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining retail sales (RSAFS below 380,000 million dollars), consumer spending weakness reduces corporate revenue expectations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not negative in more than 60% of periods where RSAFS is below 380,000 million dollars, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.
